description: This file contains utility functions related to transforming role data into a roadmap model, calculating progress, coercing statuses, and building mock role details for a career navigation platform. It appears to be part of the frontend codebase handling role and skill data visualization and processing.

methods.name: transformRoleToRoadmap(roleDetail)
methods.description: Converts a role detail object with skills and sub-skills into a structured roadmap with milestones, sub-milestones, and dependencies.

methods.name: calculateProgress(roadmapModel)
methods.description: Calculates the overall progress of a given roadmap model based on the statuses of its milestones.

methods.name: coerceStatus(status)
methods.description: Normalizes a status string to one of the accepted statuses: 'Not Started', 'In Progress', or 'Completed'.

methods.name: buildMockRoleDetail(name = 'Target Role (mock)')
methods.description: Generates a mock role detail object with predefined skills and sub-skills, useful for fallback when backend data is unavailable.
